balls.text: comes down the pitch and punches this to long-on, but Mitchell McClenaghan charges in for the second, so Suchith has to turn back. He manages to make it back
good strike from the batsman! He gets a low full toss and drives it powerfully down the ground for a couple of runs
bowls a slower delivery outside off but Suchith throws his bat and manages to slice it over point for a couple of runs
bowls a slower delivery wide outside off, but this is past the marker. Easy call for the umpire
looks for the yorker but it's a full toss, McClenaghan pushes it to long on to bring the 150 of the team

two in two! Naman Ojha has taken his second wonderful catch of the series. Vinay gets a slower delivery, he throws his hands at that, gets a thick outside edge and Naman flies to his right to pluck it inches off the ground, one-handed. Excellent stuff

superb bowling from Bhuvneshwar! Pollard ran out of options - he had to hit out, but this is a beautifully disguised slower delivery, lands on a length and keeps coming in. Pollard swings his bat at that but misses and the ball flattens the leg stump
bowls it full and wide outside off, Pollard reaches out and gets a bottom edge towards point. Just a single and that is yet another fantastic over from Boult
another slower delivery to Pollard, this time from round the wicket. He drags it with a powerful pull towards the cow corner, but that area is well manned. Just a couple
full and outside off, the batsman slices it through point but the fielder slows it down. Just a single to the deep
good bit of timing from Suchith! He gets a good yorker as he tries to make room, but manages to whip it over midwicket with a lot of timing. Bopara has to run hard to keep it in
slower delivery on off stump, Pollard comes forward and slaps it powerfully to deep midwicket
aims for this wide yorker but it is too far away, easy call for the umpire
super start to the over! He fires this one short and wide outside off.. With Pollard moving to the leg side to make room, the ball is always going away from him. The batsman misses it completely
finally gets one in the blockhole, Pollard pushes it to long on for a quick single
attempts a slower ball but this slides down the leg side too
this time he has read the pace very well! A low full toss on the pads again, he doesn't try to hit it too hard, just times it over midwicket and it smashes the advertising hoardings on the full
fires it full but this is down the leg side

he is completely beaten on this one but the outside edge takes it over cover and to the boundary! He was looking to flick this low full toss through the leg side but is too early on the shot, gets a thick leading edge

another wicket! Praveen bowls another fantastic slower delivery. Harbhajan was running out of options and he had to throw his bat at that. But he ends up slicing it towards wide long-on and is gobbled up by the fielder there. Mumbai Indians continue to slide
slower delivery outside off, Harbhajan was shaping to whack it down the ground but has to adjust, he ends up chopping it to point
targets the blockhole again, Pollard pushes it to long off with soft hands for a single
he too looks for the yorker but misses the line, this is down the leg side
bowls a quicker length delivery outside off, Harbhajan looks to cut but misses it completely
bowls a smart low full toss on the stumps, almost in the block hole, Harbhajan pushes it straight to midwicket

a low full toss brings him a wicket! It was there in the hitting zone... and maybe Pollard would have sent it in the stands.. but all Rayudu could do is time it straight to long-on. Boult is not going to let these go.
slower delivery outside off, Rayudu looks to guide this to third man but misses it completely
leans forward and punches the length delivery to deep cover

what timing from the outside half of the bat! He comes forward to push this length delivery down the ground, but gets it off the outside edge through cover.. it has enough legs to beat the fielder in the circle, then the man manning the boundary
this time he goes for the pull on this quick bouncer but it's nowhere where Rayudu intended! He gets a thick top edge that sails over the keeper and down to the boundary
fires a quick bouncer! Rayudu was looking to come forward but is not able to react to this, lets it go through to the keeper
full and straight on the stumps, Pollard gets his bat down in time to flick it straight to fine leg
takes a quick step down the pitch and plays a smart whippy clip off his thigh pad! That was racing along the turf and Bopara, at deep square leg, has to dive to keep it in
he moves a touch to the leg side to give himself room, dabs it straight to point and takes off. A direct hit by Dhawan and it could have been tight for Pollard
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman pushes it through point for a single
he comes forward and whips the length delivery over square leg with ease for a single. Superb over from Boult
bowls a superb slower delivery! Pollard was through with his pull shot but this arrives very very late, hops over the stumps
fuller and wider outside off, Rayudu has to reach out as he drives this to deep cover
another slower delivery, keeps Pollard waiting. The batsman can only dab it behind point for a single
slower delivery on the off stump line, Pollard comes forward and defends it to cover
length delivery wide outside off, Rayudu opens the face and runs it down to third man
flatter and this one breaks away after pitching! Pollard has to uses his reach to counter the spin as he defends

he takes the big one out! Rohit Sharma has perished in the deep. He came down the pitch and wanted to hammer it down the ground, but wasn't to the pitch of it. Once it turned a bit, Rohit was always going to struggle with his timing.   It goes high, but not long and is taken easily at long-off
bowls this one flatter, Pollard uses his reach to get closer to the pitch of the delivery and whips it through midwicket
slower and loopy this time, Rohit reaches out and drives it firmly to long off
flighted on the leg stump line, easily punched to deep midwicket for a single
full and flighted on the stumps, Rohit gets his front leg out of the way and punches it firmly to wide long-on. Steyn scampers across and fires a quick throw to keep the batsmen to one.
now fires in a fast yorker which is only off the mark by a bit, Pollard jams his bat down and it slides fine on the leg side for a boundary.
irrespective of the pitch or the heat, Steyn is bowling only one way. This time it's short and fast, rises up awkwardly on Pollard, who defends it to the off side
fires a full and fast delivery around off stump, Pollard comes forward and defends it solidly

the middle-stump takes a beating! Poor shot selection from Simmons as he goes for a cross-batted hoick off a length delivery and loses the stumps. A big shame as he was looking like he was ready for the final thrust. Steyn doesn't react much
he reaches his half-century with a powerful shot down the ground! Makes some room and bludgeons this fuller delivery all along the ground through mid-off

this is beautifully hit down the ground, but it almost ends up being a good catch. It's actually a drop. Boult had moved to his left and was there to take this low chance but cannot wrap his fingers around the ball
pushes it wide outside off as soon as he sees Simmons step out, but the batsman reaches out and drives it to long off
comes down the pitch but almost yorks himself, changes his shot and pushes it to long on with soft hands
another one that is shorter and flatter, Simmons slaps it to deep point for a single
he comes forward and punches the flighted delivery to long on
slightly short and spinning away, gives Rohit the space he needs to cut this perfectly in the gap behind point. That races to the boundary
looks to bludgeon this flighted delivery through cover but gets a thick inside edge to short fine leg
stays back and works away the slower delivery through square leg for another single
fuller delivery, he uses his wrist to work it through mid-on for a single
that's a typical Rohit shot! He leans forward to the length ball and continues with the swing, lifts it so easily over the umpire's head. It just lands over the boundary
he is getting used to Praveen's pace now, spots this slower bouncer and whacks it firmly to the cow corner. But there is protection there for the bowler
he comes forward and punches the length delivery on the up through covers, an easy single to the deep
back of length delivery on the stumps, Simmons pulls it to deep midwicket for a single
immediately Karn shortens the length, the batsman nudges it to midwicket and calls for quick single
now gets it off the middle! He cleared his front leg out and hammered it over midwicket for the first six of the match
he wanted it to send it to marine drive, but ends up getting an inside edge on to his pads
pushed through towards the leg stump line, the batsman eases it to long on for a single
comes forward to this tossed up delivery and pushes it through midwicket for a single
tossed up delivery outside off, Rohit reaches out and punches it firmly to wide long-off
slower delivery again! Simmons can only defend it back down the pitch
this was there for a hit! Full and wide outside off and Simmons drives it firmly, but hits it straight to mid-off
dabs this length delivery behind point for a quick single
superbly played! Another shorter delivery but instead of playing a forceful pull, Rohit just steers it through backward square leg.. no violence there at all
he almost gets another one! This is a slower bouncer and Simmons gets a thick top edge as he goes for the pull, but it lands safely at deep square leg
slower and wider outside off, Simmons waits and cuts it straight to point

comes forward to push it to cover, but it hits the inside half of the bat and comes back to the bowler, who ends up deflecting it towards long on. Had it hit the stumps, Rohit would have been in trouble. It wasn't far
flatter and quicker, Simmons defends it towards point this time
superbly flighted this time but this runs down for four. It drew Simmons into a drive and spun away just a bit, but the outside edge ran away quickly
leans into this flighted delivery and pushes it to long off
much slower this time, Rohit leans forward and looks to push it to mid-on but gets a leading edge towards cover
tossed up in the middle stump, the batsman eases it to long on for a single

what a soft dismissal! This was a short and slow delivery on off, Unmukt had all the time to whack it anywhere he wanted to, but in his overeagerness, he smashes it straight to the man at midwicket. Excellent start by Praveen.
fires a superb yorker now! Simmons can only dig it out towards cover for a single.
another slower delivery and again, it beats the batsman's attempted cut shot
smart change of pace from Praveen. This is 107 kph and keeps Simmons waiting. He wanted to cut that but misses it completely
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman defends it to the right of point and calls for a quick single
length delivery outside off, easily cut away past backward point
length delivery on the stumps, Unmukht defends it towards mid-on. Steyn has a few things to tell him
superb shot! This is off the middle and good looking too. He just leans forward to meet the fuller delivery, just pushes it through extra cover beautifully. That came in at 146 kph and went faster

he repeats the shot but has overcooked this shot! This came a bit quicker and that probably messed up with Parthiv's placement. Even though he made a good connection, he hit it straight to the man stationed at the boundary. A good catch there. A meter here of there and this could have been a six
on the pads and this time Parthiv picks his spot! He swings across the line, uses a bit of wrist and whips it through backward square leg for a boundary
back of length outside off, Simmons wanted to pull it but it comes slow off the surface. He ends up mistiming it through square leg
length delivery on the pads, Parthiv is keen to keep going as he flicks this over square leg. However, there is not much timing and it lands safely before reaching the man in the deep
full and swinging, this misses the batsman's intended big hit and rolls to the off side after hitting the pads
comes down the pitch again and looks to hit it through off but gets a thick inside edge to midwicket
uses his feet and punches this length delivery to wide mid-off. Warner moves to his left quickly but the ball rolls under his left hand, that races away quickly
gets some away swing as he pushes this wide outside off. Simmons finally takes a forward stride to drive this, but gets a thick outside edge to third man
some width provided, the batsman cuts it firmly  but cannot beat the man at point
he waits on the back foot and punches the length delivery to the off, but finds the man at cover
comes out of the crease and looks to thrash this through cover but makes no connection. That slides past the outside edge
stays on the back foot and dabs it towards mid-off, calls for a quick single realising the fielder is a bit deep
another thick outside edge! The batsman was looking to steer this to third man but this one slides off the face and beats the lone slip. Runs away to the boundary quickly
he punches this fuller delivery back at the bowler. Steyn sticks his boot out and the ricochet takes it to backward square leg, easy single
keeps it full outside off, Parthiv is a bit tentative to come forward, pushes this towards cover
full and swinging outside off, Simmons pushes at it from the crease, gets a thick outside edge to third man
he bowls a slower ball, maybe it's a sign of lack of swing, Simmons dabs it towards square leg and takes off for a quick single
length delivery angling across the right-hander, Simmons covers the line of the stumps and lets it go through
still no swing, this is on a length and Parthiv allows it to come to him, then whips it to deep midwicket with ease
back of length outside off, Simmons waits on the back foot and dabs it to the left of cover, calls for a quick single
waits in the crease and steers the length delivery towards point
this is just back of length on off stump, doesn't swing much and Parthiv nudges it to fine leg with a whippy shot
he was waiting for the shorter length, just short-arm-jabs it through midwicket. But Warner has put some protection in the deep
and yet another one down the leg side. This is the third of the over
gives away another extra as it swings down the leg side
back of length on a tight line around off, Parthiv defends it to the off side
loses direction as this one swings down the leg side
good wrist work from Parthiv! He stayed in the crease to this fuller delivery and just whips it over midwicket for his first boundary
fuller and on the pads, Parthiv looks to work it away on the leg side but misses it. Bhuvi thinks about asking a question, but that has pitched outside leg
gets this to swerve away a touch from a length, Parthiv defends it off the back foot
length delivery on off, Parthiv dabs it towards cover and thinks about a single, but he is sent back
waits on the back foot and defends the length delivery calmly to the off side
this is a good start from Simmons. He gets a full and swinging delivery, but this is on the leg stump line and he flicks it away through square leg easily
angles it away from the right-hander, Simmons comes forward and pushes inside the line, beaten
attempts the yorker but loses it a bit, wide outside off
on the pads, Simmons knows it is always going to come in, he waits a bit and whips it through midwicket. Nicely done. Once it beats the man at midwicket, it runs through
this is a little too full, allows the batsman to carve it through extra cover for a couple of runs. He wasn't moving his feet, but the length allowed him to play it comfortably
superb delivery to start, full and swinging in towards Simmons' pads, the batsman just manages to get some bat on it as he plays it to midwicket
comes down the pitch and squeezes the fuller delivery to wide long-off
walks too far to the off side and misses the slower ball again
reads the slower delivery perfectly and smashes it over extra cover, it just bounces before the boundary
he walks all the way to the off side to lap this slower delivery but misses it completely
fired quick and full on the pads, the batsman looks to swing it to the leg side but makes no connection. They take a leg bye to the off side
slower delivery on the stumps, Karn chips it over the bowler's head and comes back for the second
shorter delivery on the stumps, the batsman looks to pull but misses, gets hit on the body
bowls a slower delivery outside off that Karn misses completely. Wonder why he didn't go for his trusted delivery

it's the third wicket in this over! Another slower one does the job. Steyn swings too early, hits it too high but not long. Pollard runs in from long off and comfortably settles under the skier. Malinga is on a hat-trick
and he gets another one! Praveen charges down the pitch, gets a slower delivery that beats the bat and grazes the top of middle stump. Malinga is running through the side now
he is through with his swing before the ball arrives, makes no connection

and another one departs! Vihari has a swing at a Malinga slower delivery and all he can do is edge it to the keeper. There was a faint edge on that one. Malinga turned back to appeal but the umpire had already raised the finger
superb over from McClenaghan! He finishes his spell with an accurate yorker
another one in the blockhole, Vihari can only push it to deep midwicket

length ball, Bopara made a good connection but there was absolutely no distance on that... it is swallowed up by the man at deep midwicket easily. Pandya there, who is ecstatic after competing the catch. Sunrisers continue to slide
fires it in the blockhole, the batsman jams his bat down and takes off for a single to mid-off. There is a direct hit but he is well inside the crease
short ball from round the wicket, this one gets big on the batsman but Bopara manages to play a controlled pull behind square for a single
fires a low full toss wide outside off and Bopara, in an effort to go too inside out, misses it completely
he picks up a boundary off the last ball as he gets a toe-end to this leg-side yorker and manages to play it perfectly in the gap at short fine leg. That races away
slower delivery wide outside off, Vihari swings across the line and makes no connection
he digs this bouncer out towards cover and takes off for a single. Rohit fires a throw but misses the stumps
can't do much about that yorker! It misses the bat, it misses the stump

beautifully timed! He gets a full delivery outside off and he slices it over point, but Pandya has done brilliantly in the outfield! He dives full length at the boundary and keeps it in. That was a fantastic save
he has hit the stumps on his way. It's a Finn no-ball! This was a slower ball and the batsman dabbed it to point for a single
full and wide outside off, Bopara chases it, gets a thick outside edge but the third-man cuts it off
another wide yorker, but this time he chases it and gets a thick outside edge that runs down the boundary
very smartly  bowled! This is a wide yorker and the batsman leaves it alone thinking it is a wide, but it's well within the marker
this one is pulled really well! This was bowled at Vinay's normal pace and Vihari gets on top of that really well, picks up the gap between long on and deep midwicket perfectly
he reads the slower delivery well and drags this one towards wide long-on, but Pollard moves to his right quickly and keeps them to just a single
clever change of pace from Vinay! This one cuts away from the batsman after pitching, Bopara misses it completely
length delivery outside off, Vihari steers it down to third man and gives Bopara the strike
fuller on the stumps, the batsman drives it firmly but straight to cover
end of a cumbersome innings from Rahul! He throws his bat at this length ball without really getting into a good position. The result: no distance, only height. Rayudu takes an easy catch at long off
looks to pull it from the front foot but doesn't get much timing, ends up dragging it to long on
fires in a yorker wide outside off, the batsman can only dig it out towards extra cover
this lands just short of the deep cover fielder as Bopara charges down the pitch and looks for the big hit.. It flew off the outside half of the bat
he calmly places this length delivery through backward point and calls back for a second, charges in to make it through easily
superb over by Harbhajan as Rahul clips this tossed up delivery straight to midwicket
an outside edge now as this one doesn't turn, Bopara gets a leading edge through cover
now this one turns in, hits the inside edge and rolls towards midwicket
looks to push the flighted delivery through off but plays inside the line, gets beaten

wonderful work by Simmons at the deep backward square leg boundary! He chased this sweep shot from fine leg, keeps this one in with his first lunge, rolls over the boundary himself, then has to dive in to push the ball in again. Smart work
he stands upright and punches the quicker delivery down to long on for a single
looks for the reverse paddle but this is almost yorker length, ends up bunting it on the pitch
goes deep in the crease and punches it to long off for a single

superb hit this one! Bopara leans forward and drives it beautifully over the bowler's head, this was golf swing and it lands just in front of the boundary skirting. Pollard from long off made a diving attempt but he was never really close to it
he comes forward and nudges it through midwicket for a single
this one is a teaser for the man at cow corner! Rahul cleared his front leg out and slogged it over to the leg side, but didn't get the best of connections, just clears Vinay
steps out and drives the fuller delivery down to long-on for a single
comes forward and drives it down to long-on. Another good over for Mumbai Indians
tossed up delivery, the batsman clips it with the turn through square leg and come back for two
tossed up delivery on the stumps, pushed straight to midwicket
he waits on the back foot and punches it to extra cover
goes deep in the crease for this flatter one, flat bats it down to long on
he aims for a reverse sweep but plays all around that one, gets hit on the pads
leaves the crease again, and forces it down to long one for another single
down the track, but can only drill the tossed up ball along the ground to long off
tucks a length ball to deep midwicket off the pad
can't get it past extra cover now
tries to paddle it, mishits it well in front of square
shortens the length and does him in as he comes down the track, he has to stretch a long way to push it to covers

chance, Rohit had to jump high at extra cover and stretch his right hand over his head, he made a good effort, but the ball just brushed his fingers, Rahul survives, was looking to glide this possibly squarer
dabs another short of a length ball just past the keeper, third man runs around and gets the throw back, there is an appeal for a run-out at the striker's end, but he is comfortably in with a dive
cramps him with a lifting short of a length ball, he pushes it to extra cover
width from just back of a length, he cannot place the cut wide of the sweeper
good length ball, inches outside off, defended tightly
has him reaching forward again, and he squeezes it back to the bowler
tossed up nicely again, pushed to the bowler with a forward stretch

this is the repeat of Rohit Sharma dismissal! Ojha wanted to hit it out of the ground, he is not to the pitch of the delivery and so, ends up to-ending it towards long-off where Pollard takes an easy catch
he comes forward and pushes it to wide long off and calls for a quick couple
looks for the big hit down the ground but gets a thick outside edge as he is not to the pitch of the delivery, fortunately for Ojha, it lands safely at deep cover
tossed up delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it to mid-on
comes beside the line of this delivery and cuts it down to third man for a single
back of length delivery outside off, Rahul rides the bounce and punches it to deep point
a very very slow slower bouncer this time. But it doesn't lack bounce. Goes over the batsman's shoulder and reaches the keeper after second bounce
he looks to punch the length delivery without any feet movement and gets a thick outside edge that flies quickly down to third man
back of length and just outside off, Rahul waits on the crease and runs it down to third man
Pollard dives at point to intercept Ojha's cut shot but doesn't stop it cleanly, allows a single
back of length outside off, the batsman punches it through cover off the back foot
keeps it tight on the stumps, the batsman pushes it to wide long on for a single
flatter and quicker on the stumps, the batsman stays back and punches it down to long on
takes a step down the crease and flicks the flighted delivery through square leg again
comes forward to the flighted delivery but gets an inside edge through square leg
he waits in the crease, then works it away through square leg
flatter delivery, pushed to cover

Malinga takes a stunner! The pull shot was on, and Dhawan had timed it well too, but he couldn't keep it down. Malinga at midwicket is quick to react as he stays low and wraps his finger around the stinger. That shot flew to him in no time
gets a touch squared up as he looks to play this back of length delivery through leg side, the leading edge takes it past cover though
comes forward and pushes the length delivery towards cover point
back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it towards point
looks to chop the length delivery down to third man but doesn't get it off the middle, straight to Harbhajan at gully
fuller delivery but this slides down the leg side
That is beautifully played! It looked like a dab down to third man, but this is ver well controlled.. It's square enough to beat the first slip and fine enough to beat third man

he has upper cut this into the hands of the third man! The shot was on - this was a short delivery on off stump - but the lack of pace meant Warner could not get any distance. The danger man is gone. Malinga gives him a bit of send-off as well, Warner responds with words
slower delivery on off, the batsman chops it towards point

oh superbly done! There was nothing wrong with the ball there. It was a length delivery on the stumps, Dhawan defends it down the pitch, but you only realise the timing on that when you see the mid-off fielder chasing it. Poor effort from Vinay who slides and fails to keep it in
slower delivery this time, Dhawan guides it straight to the man at point again
another low full toss, Dhawan misses out as he slices it straight to point
this one was headed for the boundary too, but a diving Rohit Sharma at cover keeps them to one. It was an attempted yorker, but ended up being a low full toss. Warner timed it really well too
finishes the over with a solid front-foot defensive shot

add six to that! It seemed like Dhawan was beaten on length as he went down for a sweep, it was too full. But he went on with the shot and manages to scoop it over square leg. Gets the distance as well
now he jumps out of the crease and whips the tossed up delivery through midwicket. There is so much timing on that one the man on deep had no chance
picks up the gap with precision! Waits on the back foot and cuts it expertly in the tiny gap at backward point
superb delivery! This is tossed up, dips and spins past the outside edge. Parthiv takes the bails off, but Dhawan has his backfoot firmly behind the line
here comes the reverse-paddle! Dhawan is quick in his position and plays it from the middle stump line. No chance for short third man there. That ran away fine
ends an excellent over with a poor delivery, this is full and wide outside off and Warner reaches out to slice it through backward point
now a superb slower delivery! Warner was sucked into playing a forceful drive but meets only thin air.
another yorker, this one is on off stump and the batsman digs it out towards the left of mid-off, takes a single
superb delivery! Now that is a Malinga special. It's full and swings in late, beats the bat and beats the leg stump as well.
tails in towards the pads again and this time Dhawan is able to find the gap between midwicket and square leg, gets two
swings towards the pads, Dhawan comes forward and defends it towards midwicket
he dabs the back of length delivery to the off side and calls for a quick single
superb timing! This is only a touch fuller and Dhawan meets the ball beautifully.. just shows it the full face and it races away through covers
another tight delivery on the middle stump line, Dhawan can only defend it back down the pitch
this one hurries Dhawan for pace, comes in rapidly after hitting back of length. The batsman defends it down the pitch
floats this fuller and wider outside off, Dhawan thinks about going after it but leaves it alone
back of length delivery outside off, Dhawan punches it off the back foot to point
quicker one again, the batsman reaches out and pushes it to extra cover
this one keeps in with the arm and hits him on the pads, but it was going down the leg side
hammered away through covers with ease! He waits in the crease, allows the ball to come in, then crunches it through cover point
uses his feet to reach the pitch of the delivery and drives it to long off
flatter this time, Dhawan cuts it but finds the man at backward point
tossed up outside off, Dhawan needs no invitation.. he drives it handsomely through cover. Only timing there. Pollard ran all the way from wide long off to cover that, but just can't keep it in
